title.zh: 卷六 帝紀第六 中宗元帝 肅宗明帝
title.en: Volume 6 Annals 6: Emperor Yuan; Emperor Ming
title.raw: 卷六 帝紀第六 中宗元帝 肅宗明帝 Volume 6 Annals 6: Emperor Yuan; Emperor Ming

sentences.zh: 元皇帝諱睿，字景文，宣帝曾孫，琅邪恭王覲之子也。

translations.literal: The Emperor Yuan's taboo name was Rui, his courtesy name Jingwen; he was a great-grandson of Emperor Xuan and the son of Jin, Prince Gong of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan, whose personal name was Rui and courtesy name Jingwen, was a great-grandson of Emperor Xuan of Jin and the son of Sima Jin, Prince Gong of Langye.
